policy.note: The library supplies graph targets and relation paths only when external KG retrieval is unavailable or empty. Every variation changes one facet family and locks the others.

snowman.source_prompt: A single friendly snowman made from three stacked snow spheres, centered on a neutral studio background, coal eyes and buttons, carrot nose, twig arms, black top hat and red scarf, full object visible.

original.label: CreativeFlow Original
original.prompt: Preserve snowman identity while applying a holistic analogy selected from the knowledge graph.

low_fidelity.label: CreativeFlow Low Fidelity
low_fidelity.prompt: Change only the outer contour, proportions and mass distribution through analogy; preserve snowman identity, parts, accessories and materials.

part.label: CreativeFlow Part
part.prompt: Replace only the snowman's nose inside the supplied brush mask; preserve all content outside the mask.

texture.label: CreativeFlow Texture
texture.prompt: Change only material, surface microstructure and finish through analogy; preserve snowman identity, geometry, silhouette and part layout exactly.
